description: Defines a template class SingleClientServer for managing a WebSocket server with start and stop functionalities, including connection handling and logging.

classes.name: SingleClientServer
classes.description: A template class for a WebSocket server managing a single client connection, with start and stop methods.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WebSocket server on a specified port, setting connection callbacks.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket server and closes connections.
